Episode 257. The Demon Army' Attack (1)
Streamlined, pure white flying ships were endlessly emerging from the dimensional gate.
The White Fleet.
The war machines of the Demon Army, which had conquered all dimensions alongside Kelliark until now, instantly covered the domain of Morganil and cast a thick, vast shadow.
The dimensional gate that had opened in the sky was not a single one. White ships were emerging from over a hundred dimensional gates that were open like a honeycomb.
The coalition, with the flying fortress Lafrarosa at its head, immediately entered a state of battle readiness, but even at a glance, their numerical inferiority was stark.
“As expected, what's in the arrangement seems to be quite important to those bastards as well.”
“Indeed, Chiron. I had a feeling they might come, but I never thought they'd bring this many. Damn it, just how many are there?”
“Even by a rough estimate, it looks to be over a thousand.”
“This is giving me a headache.”
“Still, they don't seem to be in perfect condition. It seems there were aftereffects from the dimensional travel, Father. It looks like they came in a hurry.”
As Jin said, the White Fleet that emerged from the dimensional gates was emitting a somewhat unstable-feeling noise and vibration.
Their formation was stable, but the shield enveloping the fleet was not uniform. In other words, there was no reason to just stand by and watch.
Chk! Jin raised his sword and pointed at the White Fleet. The Golden Fleet had already finished preparing for bombardment.
“Commence firing. I will not let a single one of them escape alive.”
Kwaaaaaa...!
The moment the vivid blue rays of light split the sky, the domain of Morganil momentarily turned as white as a blank sheet of paper in that light.
The coalition still did not know the power of the Demon Army. How great their technology was, what a great fleet they possessed.
If even the Golden Fleet was no match for them, there was no hope.
'Surely, that can't be...'
Since creating the Golden Fleet, the coalition had believed that they would never be defeated in an aerial battle, no matter what enemy they met in the future.
That belief was still valid now, but the shock received from the leader of the Demon Army earlier was too great.

So, the moment the Golden Fleet's bombardment was about to clash, the coalition members waited for the result with bated breath. Because the fleet of the Demon Army, just like Kelliark, could also deliver a shock that was far beyond the scale.
Booooom, Kdeudeudeuk...!
A familiar sound of explosion was heard. To the coalition members, the moment the enemy fleet's shield shattered looked like a slow-motion scene.
A moment later, the sight of the white ships that had been in the vanguard falling also followed. Only after confirming that did the coalition members breathe a sigh of relief.
Because that meant it was a winnable fight. Of course, the state of the White Fleet was not normal, but it certainly did not seem that the Demon Army' fleet technology was ahead of the coalition's.
“Huuu.”
“Were you nervous, youngest?”
“Honestly, I did wonder what we would do if the fleet was also like that man, Kelliark. And in that fleet... he is not there.”
The moment the dimensional gates opened, the Genesis Knights, including Jin, had first tried to read Kelliark's energy. Fortunately, he was not on board any of the white ships.
“Still, a great energy... I can feel quite a lot of it, Brother Jin. We must be careful.”
The Genesis Knights nodded heavily at Vahn's words.
The domain that she would appraise as needing to 'be careful' of course meant Genesis Knights.

The Demon Army was a group that had conquered all dimensions except for this 677th dimension. Naturally, even excluding the monster named Kelliark, they possessed Genesis Knights, and what's more, their number was dozens of times greater than the coalition's. It was just that they could not all gather in one place due to the restrictions of dimensional travel.
“Three of them for now, is it. Well, by the standards of all dimensions, a Genesis Knight probably isn't such a rare domain.”
As Luna said, cloaking Krantel in crimson energy, Chiron and Vahn gave a strange smile.
“Just as not all 10-star mages are the same, the same goes for Genesis Knights.”
“We'll have to show them who the strongest in all dimensions is.”
“Uh, Vahn. Isn't that the Kelliark Zipfel of the Demon Army?”
“I haven't properly fought that man yet. Isn't that right, Chiron?”
“That's right. Show us your skills, Vahn. I was just wondering about your full strength.”
“My full strength, you say. If the opportunity comes, I shall show you. But I hope that it is not now.”
Chiii, Booooom...!
The vanguard of the White Fleet was continuously being shot down. It seemed they were so focused on defense that they couldn't even think of counterattacking.
It meant it was the best time for the coalition's Genesis Knights and superhumans to infiltrate the enemy lines. However, Jin was not giving the order.
Because there was a more efficient means of attack remaining first.
The Plutonian Cannon.
The main cannon of the flying fortress Lafrarosa was aiming at the White Fleet. While the fleet was continuously carrying out its bombardment, Lafrarosa had only been amplifying its power.
[Kraaaaaak! Keo-eot!]
[Hang in there, Subordinate No. 1!]
[Kkyukkyukkyu!]
Inside the power room of Lafrarosa, the three egos of the Sun God were shouting. Especially Beltian, who was bound by restraints, looked as if he would explode at any moment, his entire body swollen.
Originally, the power source named Beltian possessed a power that was close to infinite. But right now, Beltian was emitting an energy far more powerful than what Dr. Qwaul had expected.
The reason for that was the dimensional gates used by the Demon Army.

As could be told from the form where the Milky Way seemed to flow inside the gates, those dimensional gates were opened based on Malugia's power. The Demon Army had opened the dimensional gates using the traces left by this dimension's Malugia, who had fought Kelliark a while ago, and the authority of the Malugias from other dimensions that they had previously captured.
The point that the Demon Army had missed was the fact that the Vamel Alliance possessed a flying fortress that operated with an ego of destruction as its power source.
[Malugia... have you come to save me! Kraaaaaah!]
[Good, just a little more, a little more! Done! Hey, Baba! It's complete!]
[Kkyu!]
Bluggiet's voice echoed through the ship's communicator to the bridge of Lafrarosa.
“Plutonian Cannon fi... no, wait a moment. Brother Boras, this power level is too high. Is it okay to fire?”
“First, tell the Genesis Knights to prepare! No, I'll do it. Sister Goddess of Battle, prepare a solid shield. If you get caught in the aftershock, even a brother will get hurt!”

The Genesis Knights, excluding Chiron, immediately agreed with Boras's opinion. Because all of them, except for him, had directly experienced the bombardment of the Red Plutonians' flying fortress. Of course, the Plutonian Cannon was on a level that couldn't even be compared to that.
“Youngest, is that thing called the Plutonian Cannon that powerful?”
“Right now, it seems the power is even stronger because of Malugia's energy. Come this way, Father.”
The five Genesis Knights stuck close together and formed a shield.
“Fire!”
The moment Baba's firing command fell.
Pzzzzzt...!
The Genesis Knights couldn't help but be shocked as they saw cracks immediately forming on the shield that the five of them had combined their strength to create.

It hadn't even been a direct hit; just the aftershock had lightly touched them. Of course, it wasn't a shield that the Genesis Knights had formed with their full strength, but it wasn't something they had put up carelessly either.
The allied Genesis Knights were more flustered than the enemies. They hastily reinforced their shield and looked in the direction the Plutonian Cannon had been fired.
A golden tsunami that swallowed everything was unfolding.

The sight of not only the sky, which had been shining a vivid blue from the previous bombardment, but also the vast land, which had been writhing with an intense life force, all being swept away by the golden tsunami that Lafrarosa had spewed out, could be seen.
The Genesis Knights were momentarily at a loss for words before the spectacle, for which the expression 'erases' was more appropriate than concepts like destroying or breaking.

The numerous white ships were so obscured by the Plutonian Cannon that they couldn't even be seen. It seemed as if the Plutonian Cannon had swallowed up even the dimensional gates they had emerged from.
'I had heard an explanation from Dr. Qwaul about the power of the Plutonian Cannon, but... this is shocking.'
If I were hit by the Plutonian Cannon head-on, could I really withstand it?
The Genesis Knights, including Vahn and Chiron, were at a point where they couldn't quickly answer that question that had reflexively popped into their heads.
“Huh? Wait, kid. This, is the arrangement okay? It wouldn't be strange if even the arrangement were swept away and disappeared.”
“That place is fine. It's certain, so don't worry.”
“...At this level, it wouldn't be strange if the enemy Genesis Knights were killed in action.”
“Indeed.”
It was a single shot.

However, the golden tsunami continued to be maintained for over five minutes. Due to the heat, the Genesis Knights still did not come out of their shield, and the allied fleet had also entered Lafrarosa's shield and ceased its bombardment.
The bombardment began to weaken a little around the 7-minute mark, and it ended completely at the exact 10-minute mark.
After their vision cleared, the first thing that came into the coalition members' eyes was the wreckage of the White Fleet, piled up on the ground like abandoned corpses.
It was the wreckage of the rear guard. Because the fleet that had been in front of it had melted and disappeared without even a trace.
If what had first appeared was the entirety of the enemy, the coalition would have seized victory in a single blow.
However, most of the dimensional gates from which the White Fleet had emerged were still being maintained, and from within them, new fleets were emerging and forming ranks.
The White Fleet once again filled the sky in an instant, but the Genesis Knights were more conscious of the Plutonian Cannon than of them.
The Plutonian Cannon had also finished reloading.
“Youngest, how many more times can the flying fortress fire?”
“Originally, it was more than 10 times without maintenance, but now that the output has increased, it will be less than that. Let's move further to the rear before the bombardment proceeds.”
“Huh? What. Like Vahn said, one Genesis Knight really did die? The other two don't seem to be in a normal state either.”

As Murakan said, one of the three Genesis Knights of the Demon Army had been killed in action by the recent bombardment, and two had been critically wounded. Those remaining two were also scheduled to surely die in the next bombardment that would begin soon.

“...So the ones who come from now on will probably be prepared to some extent. We have to hold out until the curse is lifted, so we'll have to hope that their reinforcements are cut off before we use up all the shots of the Plutonian Cannon.”
